newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly fall with IPE futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly fall with IPE futures.

text.p: NWE oil products were weaker on Tuesday as crude futures fell sharply, traders said.
Gasoline barges and cargoes fell sharply although news of a fresh refinery run cutback was supportive. Eurograde barges changed hands at $204-$206 fob ARA.
Naphtha weakened with crude although healthy reforming margins kept n+a material at a $2 premium to full-range material.
Gas oil weakened in line with futures, although premiums were little changed. Heating oil barges traded at June IPE +$1.25 and $1.50 fob ARA.
High sulphur barges fell to $78/$80 on aggressive selling by one player at $78. Low sulphur swaps fell on weaker futures but no physical deals were seen.
